annotation.interpretation_a: The ticket_lifetime field is ignored, and all tickets are invalidated after 7 days.
annotation.interpretation_b: The ticket_lifetime field specifies the maximum validity period, but the client MUST NOT cache beyond 7 days, even if ticket_lifetime is greater than 7 days. This implies a minimum of 7 days, but the client can choose to honor the ticket_lifetime if it is less than 7 days.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'regardless of the ticket_lifetime' creates ambiguity. Does it mean the ticket_lifetime is entirely ignored, or that the 7-day limit overrides any longer lifetime specified in the ticket? Both interpretations are reasonable.
